--- list basics
on t(l)
    return {count of l, length of l, first item of l, last item of l, rest of l, reverse of l, items 2 thru -1 of l, some item of l, l contains 1, {1} is in l, l & {9}, {0} & l, l's item 2, class of l}
end t
--- list mutation
on t(l)
    set end of l to 1
    set beginning of l to 0
    set item 2 of l to "x"
    set l's last item to "z"
    set l to l & {5, 6}
    set l to rest of l
    set l to reverse of l
    set l to items 1 thru -2 of l
    return l
end t
--- list of lists
on t(m)
    set total to 0
    repeat with row in m
        repeat with cell in row
            set total to total + cell
        end repeat
    end repeat
    set item 2 of item 1 of m to 0
    return {total, item 1 of item 2 of m, count of item 1 of m, m's item 1's item 1}
end t
--- list filter by loop
on t(l)
    set out to {}
    repeat with x in l
        if (contents of x) > 2 then set end of out to contents of x
    end repeat
    return out
end t
--- list index of
on indexOf(l, v)
    repeat with i from 1 to count of l
        if item i of l is v then return i
    end repeat
    return 0
end indexOf
--- list class filters
on t(l)
    return {integers of l, reals of l, strings of l, lists of l, records of l, booleans of l, numbers of l, every integer of l, first integer of l, last string of l, count of integers of l, count integers of l}
end t
--- record basics
on t(r)
    return {name of r, r's name, count of r, length of r, r & {extra:1}, {extra:1} & r, r as list, class of r, r contains {name:"a"}, {name:"a"} is in r}
end t
--- record mutation
on t(r)
    set name of r to "n"
    set r's size to 3
    set r to r & {added:true}
    set alpha of r to (alpha of r) + 1
    set end of items_ of r to 4
    set item 1 of items_ of r to 0
    return r
end t
--- record labels kinds
on t()
    return {name:"n", |name|:"u", size:1, |size|:2, id:3, |id|:4, class:"c", |class|:"d", alpha:5, |alpha beta|:6, x:7, |end|:8, |it|:9, result:10, |result|:11}
end t
--- nested records
on t(r)
    return {a of b of c of r, r's c's b's a, name of first item of rows of r, (name of r) & (id of r), count of rows of r, a of (item 1 of rows of r)}
end t
--- record iteration by list
on t(rs)
    set names to {}
    repeat with r in rs
        set end of names to (name of r) & ":" & (value of r)
    end repeat
    return names
end t
--- booleans
on t(a, b)
    set x to true
    set y to false
    set z to a and not b
    if a then set x to not x
    if a = true then set y to true
    if b is false then set y to false
    return {x, y, z, a as integer, b as text, not a, a ≠ b, a = b}
end t
--- numbers
on t(n)
    return {n + 1, n - 1, n * 2, n / 2, n div 2, n mod 2, n ^ 2, -n, n as integer, n as real, round n, n > 0, n ≥ 0, n = 0, n is not 0, (n + 0.5) div 1, n mod 1, n ^ 0.5}
end t
--- integer limits
on t()
    return {536870911, 536870912, -536870911, -536870912, -536870913, 1073741824, 2.0E+9, 99999999, 100000000, 123456789}
end t
--- dates
on t()
    set d to current date
    set e to d + 1 * days
    set f to d - 2 * weeks
    set g to (e - d) div hours
    set day of d to 1
    set month of d to January
    set year of d to 2020
    set time of d to 12 * hours + 30 * minutes
    return {d, e, f, g, month of d, month of d as integer, weekday of d, d < e, date string of d, short date string of d, time string of d, d as text}
end t
--- date arithmetic
on t(d, e)
    return {d + 60, d - 3600, d + 2 * days, e - d, (e - d) / days, (e - d) div minutes, d > e, d = e, d ≥ e, d's month, d's weekday as integer, year of d - year of e, (month of d) * 1}
end t
--- month and weekday tests
on t(d)
    if month of d is January then return 1
    if weekday of d is in {Saturday, Sunday} then return 2
    if month of d is not December and day of d > 15 then return 3
    return month of d as integer
end t
--- missing value handling
on t(x)
    if x is missing value then set x to "default"
    if x = missing value then return 1
    if x ≠ missing value and x is not "" then return 2
    set y to missing value
    return {x, y, y is missing value, class of y}
end t
--- class and coercion tests
on t(x)
    return {class of x, class of x is list, class of class of x, x as list, x as text, {x} as text, (x as list) & {1}, count of (x as list), class of (x as text)}
end t
--- data and raw values
on t()
    return {«data utxt00480069», «class null», «class furl», «constant ****pict», «data TEXT68656C6C6F»}
end t
--- alias and file values
on t(p)
    set a to alias p
    set f to file p
    set g to POSIX file p
    set h to a as text
    set i to f as alias
    return {a, f, g, h, i, class of a, a as «class furl», POSIX path of a}
end t
--- constants
on t()
    return {yes, no, ask, true, false, missing value, null, current application, it, me, pi, space, tab, return, linefeed, quote, minutes, hours, days, weeks, AppleScript, version, AppleScript's version}
end t
--- units of measure
on t(x)
    return {x as miles, (x as kilometers) as number, x as pounds, x as grams, x as liters, x as degrees Celsius, x as degrees Kelvin, (x as feet) as inches as number, x as yards, x as ounces, x as quarts, x as cubic meters, x as square feet}
end t
--- big literal mix
on t()
    return {1, "a", 2.5, true, {2, "b", {3, "c", {4, "d"}}}, {k:1, l:{m:2, n:{o:3}}}, missing value, pi, {}, "", 0, -1, {{}}, {a:{}}}
end t
--- swapping and tuples
on t(a, b)
    set {a, b} to {b, a}
    set {x, y, z} to {1, 2, 3}
    set {p, {q, r}} to {a, {b, x}}
    set {name:n, id:i} to {name:"a", id:1}
    return {a, b, x, y, z, p, q, r, n, i}
end t
--- counting kinds
on t(l)
    return {count l, count of l, count items of l, count each item of l, count every integer in l, number of items in l, number of strings of l, count l's items, (count l) = 0, (count of l) is 0, l is {}, l = {}}
end t
--- list equality and contains
on t(l)
    return {l = {1, 2}, l is {}, l is not {}, l contains 1, l contains {1, 2}, l starts with 1, l ends with {2}, {1, 2} is in l, l does not contain "a", {} is in l}
end t
--- date literals
on t()
    return {date "2/3/1970", date "12/25/2001 3:04:05 PM", date "7/4/1776 12:00:00 PM", date "3/5/2020 12:30:00 AM"}
end t
--- date literals of the Julian calendar
on t()
    return {date "10/4/1582", date "10/15/1582", date "1/1/1000", date "6/15/800 6:07:08 AM"}
end t
--- date in a property
property start : date "2/29/2000 9:05:07 AM"

on t(d)
    return d > start
end t
